reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited text supports it: § 12.3 expressly preserves Customer's freedom to hire any person responding to general recruitment and records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment, matching the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer).
No redline or comment is proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered paragraph is unchanged from the original.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are non-probative here — they presuppose an existing non-solicit covenant, and none binds Customer, so the fallback construct is not needed.
Excluding § 12.4 is appropriate: that covenant binds Vendor and benefits our party, so it is not a restrictive covenant on Customer under this rule.
